Hearth.GuideTopicDef.label: Opening day
Hearth.GuideTopicDef.description: Three steps from a bed to your first silver. No research, no zones, no settings.

li.label: Mark a bed as a guest bed, or put up a venue sign in a roofed room.
li.description: Guests only come once you have prepared something for them. Until then the game plays like vanilla.

li.label: Wait for the first guests. They arrive within about three days.
li.description: You get a letter when a group is on its way.

li.label: Let a guest pay for something.
li.description: Payments land in the till and are counted on the Overview page.

Hearth.GuideTopicDef.label: Your guests at a glance
Hearth.GuideTopicDef.description: Where to see how your guests are doing.

li.label: Open the Guests page in the Hearth & Harbor tab.
li.description: One row per guest: mood, satisfaction, budget and when they leave. Click a row to jump to the guest.

li.label: Select a guest and open the Guest tab.
li.description: Shows what the guest thinks and lets you pick Basics, Accompany or Recruit.

li.label: Try a different handling mode on a guest you like.

Hearth.GuideTopicDef.label: Your first venue
Hearth.GuideTopicDef.description: A sign turns a room into a business.

li.label: Put up a venue sign inside a roofed room.
Check the opening hours. Guests only buy while it is open.

Hearth.GuideTopicDef.label: Money in the bank
Hearth.GuideTopicDef.description: Silverline keeps your takings safe and lets guests pay by card.

li.label: Open a Silverline account at a bank building.
li.description: Optional. Without an account the bank stays out of your way.

li.label: Switch on direct deposit so the tills empty into the account.
Watch the balance on the Overview page.
